# plugin-pack's fetch (.github/workflows/ci-job-plugin-pack.yaml): the modules of internal/daemon's
# tests, which its one go test step runs, the envoy commands they build (testbuild.EnvoyBinary) and
# the legion binary the pack builds.
deps packages/daemon -test ./internal/daemon/
deps packages/envoy ./cmd/dispatch ./cmd/listener
deps packages/daemon ./cmd/legion
